messages:
Jamie (eng): Hey — quick question. I need to change my PCP on our PPO plan because my new address moved me across town. I'm mid-course with an out-of-network therapist who filed for pre-auth last month. If I switch PCPs, will that break the existing authorization or affect billing? Also, my partner lost their insurance ID card — is there a quick way to get a temporary one?
Nora (People Ops): Hi Jamie! Changing your PCP generally shouldn't retroactively invalidate an existing pre-authorization for an ongoing course of care, but policies vary by carrier. Which carrier is your plan with? Also we can issue a digital ID card instantly for dependents in most cases.
Jamie (eng): It's UnitedCare PPO (plan code UC-RED-2024). The auth was for psychotherapy (code 90834) and was submitted by the therapist last month — we have the auth number.
Luis (Benefits): @Jamie (eng) thanks for the details. UnitedCare typically ties pre-auths to the patient + provider + service type, not strictly the PCP, but there are exceptions when care coordination is tied to a PCP on file. If you can DM me the auth number I can escalate. In the meantime, you can request a temporary ID card via the carrier portal — link here: https://portal.unitedcare.example/guest-card (login with SSN + DOB).
Jamie (eng): DMed you the auth number. One more thing — the therapist wants a referral note from the PCP for continued weekly sessions. If I change PCP now will the new doctor be willing to sign off without a first intake visit? That could delay care.
Nora (People Ops): Good call. Two options: 1) Keep your current PCP on file until your therapist finishes the current authorization and referral, then update the PCP; or 2) We can request an expedited courtesy referral with UnitedCare showing continuity of care. @Luis can start the expedited request.
Luis (Benefits): @Nora (People Ops) starting the expedited continuity-of-care request now. UnitedCare's expedited form asks for: patient name, DOB, existing PCP name, new PCP (if known), provider doing the ongoing treatment, service codes, and the auth number. I submitted the form (ticket #UC-987612) — they gave an ETA of 48 hours.
BenefitsBot: Your ticket UC-987612 has been received by UnitedCare. Status: Received. Expected response: 2 business days.
Jamie (eng): Awesome, thanks. About the partner's ID card — when I go to the portal it wants the enrollee SSN, but partner doesn't have it on file (they're on as a dependent). Is there a way People Ops can send a digital card directly?
Nora (People Ops): Yes — we can request a dependent digital card from UnitedCare on your behalf if you provide partner's full name, DOB, and dependent relationship. If you're uncomfortable posting here, DM me the details or email benefits@redwood.com. We can also push a PDF to you from our broker portal in the meantime.
Maya (legal): Quick note re: mental health privacy — please ensure any messages that include specific therapy notes or diagnoses stay off-channel. Sharing auth numbers and administrative IDs is fine. Keep clinical details private per HIPAA guidance.
Jamie (eng): Thanks @Maya. I'll DM @Nora the partner details and @Luis the auth docs. Appreciate the fast help.
Luis (Benefits): Got the docs, Jamie. Submitted dependent digital card request (broker ticket #BR-5543). Broker says they can email a temporary PDF within 24 hours once they verify dependent info. I'll update this thread when they confirm.
BenefitsBot: Broker ticket BR-5543 updated: Pending dependent verification.
Insurance Rep - UnitedCare: Hello folks — this is UnitedCare support. We pulled ticket UC-987612 and will treat it as continuity of care. If you want the new PCP to endorse the referral without an intake visit, add a short attestation from the existing PCP or the treating therapist. We can accept that and issue updated referral paperwork.
Jamie (eng): Great, putting together the attestation now. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
Nora (People Ops): TL;DR for others who search this later: changing PCP usually OK for active pre-auths but confirm with carrier; we can file continuity-of-care to avoid gaps; People Ops/broker can issue dependent digital ID cards within 24 hrs after verification. DM for private info.
